description: Korn Ferry Tour leaderboard for the current or most recent tournament (or the event on a given date): tournament name, dates and status, then each player's place, name, country, score to par, round scores and total strokes, from ESPN's public golf scoreboard feed. Related tools on this server, for a different need: sports_equibase when you need horse racing entries from Equibase's free entry pages. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

date.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD to get the event played that week (default: current or most recent)

name: sports_korn_ferry_tour_leaderboard
title: Korn Ferry Tour leaderboard for the current or most recent
